column4: One single firm hammer blow driving a big nail into a thick wooden beam outdoors on a building site, a dull wooden knock with a short metallic ring of the nail, heard from a few metres away in open air, nothing else, no music, no voices.

One single hammer blow on a nail into a wooden plank outdoors, slightly lighter and higher than a heavy blow, a wooden knock with a short ring, heard from a few metres away in open air, nothing else, no music, no voices.

The last few planks of wooden scaffolding taken down and dropped onto a pile on grass outdoors, a few hollow wooden clatters and a final thud, then quiet, heard from a few metres away, no music, no voices.
